title: Banks Act Directive D2/2011 — Reporting daily value-at-risk amounts for market risk using specified items of the form BA 325
enablingLegislation: Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This directive is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Reporting daily value-at-risk amounts for market risk using specified items of the form BA 325.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This directive applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Reporting daily value-at-risk amounts for market risk using specified items of the form BA 325.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Reporting daily value-at-risk amounts for market risk using specified items of the form BA 325. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This directive remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
